column1: # Sugarat Launcher build table: the SDGOODS launcher 2.0 layout as read from a badge on 2026-11-11.
# Builds use it only for size checks; the device keeps its own table
# at runtime to place app-sized slots in the 10 MiB pool (0x310000..0xD10000). Empty OTA rows are
# size-0 entries on the device and cannot be expressed here
column2: so one row stands for the pool.
